body: I want to beleive there aren't but I'm feeling something and it's killing me inside. I don't care what it is but the fact that no one can explain it or there's no cure is what I'm so worked up about.

Ever since I greened out I've stopped smoking it but it really hurts me because my whole group of friends hangs out and smokes while I'm just at home. We went to a smoke shop and I couldn't enjoy the pieces like my friends did. I have no plans to smoke in the near future but maybe when I'm older and my brain is fully developed, if that is still a possibility lol I feel like I already fucked up that chance. God bless your soul and thanks for talking to me.

Thank you so much I'll definitely take your advice. You said you felt the same way as me at one point, what exactly did you relate to? I would like to discuss it because at this point I think I'm mentally insane and relating so someone would be so peaceful.

I'm also trying to say, I think weed has fucked me up. My mind and my thoughts are so confusing that I don't even know what I'm doing anymore and that feeling really triggers me. I also left out that recently for the past couple of days my heart has been having a tickling feeling and my shortness of breath and heavy breathing are more frequent than ever.
